extraction.text:
Hemanth SS

LLM/AI Engineer

hemanthss.career@gmail.com https://linkedin.com/in/hemanthss

+91-8086936541

Bengaluru, India

Versatile engineer with 9 years of experience spanning Python development, AI/LLM technologies, embedded systems and computer vision. Proven track record in transitioning from hardware and system integration to cutting-edge AI solutions, with recent focus on large language models, conversational AI, and intelligent automation systems.

Work Experience

AI Consultant & Freelancer	Mar 2025 - Present

Independent | Remote

Develop custom AI agents and intelligent automation solutions for enterprise clients across various industries including healthcare, sales, and customer support.

Design and implement end-to-end AI systems using LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenAI with RAG architectures for context-aware responses

Build conversational AI solutions with vector database integration (Weaviate) for efficient knowledge retrieval and response generation

Senior System Engineer	Oct 2024 - Mar 2025

Pramana | Banglore

Designed and implemented a computer vision system for the scanner cluster, which automated the previous sanity check process performed by a robotic arm.

Created a test jig for stepper motor validation, improving accuracy and repeatability

Conducted feasibility analysis for new automation initiatives and provided detailed implementation plans to developers.

System Test Engineer	Dec 2018 - Oct 2024

Tonbo Imaging | Banglore

Developed an intelligent conversational AI system using OpenAI GPT-4 API integrated with Streamlit for real-time customer query resolution. Implemented natural language processing pipeline with context-aware response generation.



Automated test procedures using Python to reduce manual effort and improve thermal sensor calibration accuracy.

Designed and implemented intuitive Python-based user interfaces (PyQt, custom Tkinter) for camera module testing, prioritizing user experience and precise results.

Set up and executed AI models on NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX and Orin NX platforms, developing proof-of-concept implementations.

Electrical Engineer	Mar 2017 - Sep 2018

Cogent Automation | Coimbatore

Drove operational efficiency by developing and implementing PLC programs.

Served as a go to expert for PLC troubleshooting, swiftly identifying and resolving issues to maintain uninterrupted production.

Enabled adaptability in various industrial settings by developing customization HMI solutions, meeting specific operational requirements.

Projects

Sales Bot with Q&A and RFP Generation	Jul 2025 - Present

Developed an intelligent sales automation system using LangChain and vector databases to handle customer queries and generate RFP responses. Integrated with multiple data sources to provide contextual answers and automated proposal generation.

Implemented RAG architecture using Weaviate vector database for efficient document retrieval

Built conversational interface using LangChain with custom prompt templates for RFP generation

Created automated RFP response pipeline with 85% accuracy in requirement matching

Deployed using LangGraph for complex multi-agent workflows and response orchestration

Doctor's Support Agent (CrewAI-Agentic RAG-OpenAI-Streamlit)	Apr 2025 - Jul 2025

Developing an AI-powered healthcare agent using CrewAI, OpenAI, and Streamlit integrated with a CI/CD pipeline to automate patient symptom analysis, disease prediction, lab test recommendation, and insurance mapping.

Built a natural language processing pipeline to extract symptoms from user input.



Implemented disease mapping logic and integrated lab test suggestion engine.

Designed an insurance mapping module based on patient insurance ID and provider rules.

Automated deployment and version control with CI/CD for reliable updates and scalability.

Loan Default Prediction Using EDA	Jul 2023 - Aug 2023

Conducted comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis using Python (Pandas, NumPy) to uncover patterns and correlations between consumer behaviors, loan characteristics, and default risks. Applied statistical analysis and feature engineering techniques to identify crucial risk factors.

Performed data preprocessing and cleaning on 50K+ loan records using Pandas and scikit- learn

Implemented correlation analysis, distribution plots, and statistical hypothesis testing using Seaborn and Matplotlib for data visualization

Generated actionable insights through feature importance analysis, reducing potential loan defaults	through data-driven risk mitigation strategies

Core Skills

Programming Language: Python

LLM & Frameworks: OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, LLaMA, CrewAI, Claude 3, RAG, QLoRA, LoRA, Hugging Face

Vector DB: Weaviate, Pinecone, Chroma db

Data bases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL

Data Visualization: Matplotlib, ggplot, Seaborn

Data Analysis: Pandas, Data cleaning, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

MLOps: Docker, CI/CD pipelines

Version Control: Git

AI tools: Claude code, github copilot, Cursor AI, Loveable.ai, Replit

Cloud Deployment: Azure, AWS



Education

IIIT-Banglore	Sep 2022 - Nov 2023

Executive Post Graduate Diploma Artificial Intelligence GPA: 3.1

Ramaiah University	Sep 2018 - Oct 2020

Bachelor of Vocational Degree Mechatronics GPA: 75

NTTF	Jun 2011 - Apr 2014

Diploma Mechatronics GPA: 75

Languages

English, Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil
